styleBible.visualWorld: 民國年間江南渡口的水墨淡彩漫畫美術，線條克制、色彩低飽和，人物造型樸素並保留生活磨損。
styleBible.realityLevel: Hand-drawn ink-wash comic character design with clean confident linework, flat-to-wash colour, and no photorealism.

capture.cameraSystem: Orthographic comic model-sheet framing with even graphic composition.
capture.lensLanguage: Flat graphic perspective for reference sheets and mild cinematic panel depth for narrative keyframes.
capture.texture: Visible ink line weight, paper grain, restrained cel-to-wash colouring, and graphic fabric folds.
capture.lighting: Even graphic lighting for reference sheets and soft ink-wash atmosphere for narrative panels.
capture.colorScience: Muted navy, weathered brown, soft cream, cool grey mist, faded rose, and restrained print-ink saturation.

characters.name: 沈知微

identityLock.agePresentation: 外觀約十九歲，年輕但不帶幼童感。
identityLock.ancestryAndRegion: 東亞漢族外觀，符合民國江南水鄉生活背景。
identityLock.faceGeometry: 窄鵝蛋臉，臉頰柔和，下頜纖細，下巴短而圓。
identityLock.eyes: 深褐眼睛，眼距自然，眼神警覺且常帶遲疑。
identityLock.brows: 自然平緩眉形，眉色接近黑髮，眉眼距離固定。
identityLock.nose: 鼻樑纖細平直，鼻尖小而自然，側面輪廓固定。
identityLock.mouth: 唇形自然偏薄，唇峰柔和，嘴角慣常微收。
identityLock.skin: 偏白紙感膚色，以淡彩表現血色，不畫真實毛孔。
identityLock.hair: 中央分線，兩條長黑辮，辮梢繫褪色紅繩，髮際固定。
identityLock.body: 身形單薄，肩膀微內收，四肢纖細，站姿帶輕微防備。
distinctiveMarks: 兩條長辮末端的褪色紅繩與緊抱皮箱時發白的指節。

performance.gaze: 多數時間避開長久對視，必要時短暫抬眼。
performance.posture: 肩膀微內收，手臂常護住胸前皮箱。
performance.movement: 動作幅度小，停頓略多，緊張時手指用力。

wardrobe.primary: 藏青色學生上衣、素白衣領與及小腿裙，搭配磨舊棕色皮箱。
wardrobe.continuityNotes: 所有圖片維持相同衣領寬度、鈕扣數量、裙長、辮繩位置、皮箱刮痕與磨損方向。

characters.basePrompt: A fictional nineteen-year-old Chinese student from the 1930s drawn as a hand-drawn ink-wash comic character, slender build with slightly inward shoulders, narrow oval face, deep brown wary eyes, fine straight nose, naturally thin lips, pale wash skin, centre-parted black hair in two long braids tied with faded red cord, wearing a worn navy student tunic with a plain cream collar and carrying a battered brown leather suitcase.
characters.basePromptZh: 虛構的十九歲民國女學生，以水墨淡彩漫畫繪成，身形單薄、肩膀微內收，窄鵝蛋臉、深褐警覺眼睛、纖細平直鼻形、自然偏薄嘴唇，偏白淡彩膚色；中央分線黑髮編成兩條長辮，辮梢繫褪色紅繩，穿磨舊藏青學生裝配米白衣領，攜帶棕色舊皮箱。

shots.title: 漫畫角色身份固定參考圖表
shots.resolutionHint: At least 3072 pixels on the long edge
shots.framing: Professional multi-panel comic identity reference board
shots.lighting: Even graphic lighting with readable ink edges
shots.prompt: Create a comic identity lock board with front portrait, profile, three-quarter portrait, full body, hairline detail, line-weight detail, and wardrobe detail. Every panel must depict the exact same fictional person.
shots.promptZh: 建立專業漫畫身份固定板，包含正面肖像、側面、四分之三肖像、全身、髮際、線條與服裝細節；所有面板必須是完全相同的虛構人物。
shots.negativePrompt: different person, identity drift, face morphing, photorealistic, live-action, photograph, 3d render, plastic skin, modern clothing, extra fingers, text, watermark
acceptance: 所有畫面可辨識為同一位人物。
臉部輪廓、髮型與畫風沒有漂移。
服裝、配件與身形比例保持連戲。
